regulator: Minnesota Department of Commerce, Securities Unit

statute.name: Minnesota Uniform Securities Act (Minn. Stat. ch. 80A)

sections.heading: Section 102; Definitions
sections.use: investment adviser and investment adviser representative definitions (subd. 16 and 17 per Commerce)

sections.heading: Section 401; Broker-dealer registration requirement and exemptions
Section 402; Agent registration requirement and exemptions
Section 403; Investment adviser registration requirement and exemptions
sections.use: state investment adviser and representative registration (Commerce cites 80A.58 and 80A.61)

sections.heading: Section 405; Federal covered investment adviser notice filing requirement
sections.use: SEC-registered adviser notice filing (not state registration)

sections.heading: Section 406; Registration by broker-dealer, agent, funding portal, investment adviser, and investment adviser representative
Section 412; Denial, revocation, suspension, withdrawal, restriction, condition, or limitation of registration
Section 605; Rules, forms, orders, interpretative opinions, and hearings

commerceStatements.access: mn.gov answers a plain HTTP client with a ShieldSquare interstitial; the pages were read in a normal Chrome session with no challenge shown.

investmentAdvisers.iaFiling: Form ADV Parts 1 and 2 on the Investment Adviser Registration Depository (IARD)
investmentAdvisers.iarFiling: Form U4 on the Central Registration Depository (CRD)
investmentAdvisers.infrastructureSupport: Commerce lists FINRA as IARD System Support; FINRA operates the system and is not the Minnesota regulator
investmentAdvisers.safeSeniors: The page links Minnesota's Safe Senior Financial Protection Act as context

brokerDealers.rule: Minn. Stat. 80A.56 and 80A.57: unlawful to transact business in Minnesota as a broker-dealer or agent unless registered or exempt
brokerDealers.filing: Broker-dealer applications are filed electronically through CRD (Minn. Stat. 80A.61; Minn. R. 2876.4062)

complaints.intake: The Commerce complaint form lists 'Securities' as a complaint type
